The specific channel used to notify the collector directly is not specified beyond general confirmation of availability."}, {"question_id": "Q4", "question": "How do you confirm that your child has arrived home safely after pickup — what does that confirmation look like and who sends it?", "answer": "The partner records a home arrival note in a family handover log after collecting the child.
